PLAN "Prenatal Strength Phase (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "maintain full-body strength through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength (Incline)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Posterior Chain + Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 6..7 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
